module_summary: Ethernet frame arbitrated mux: an arbiter grants one input per frame, a frame FSM latches the granted header, and payload passes through a skid-buffered AXI-Stream output.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame state: set at header accept, cleared on payload tlast.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-port header valid forming arbiter requests.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-port header ready pulsed for granted port at frame start.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready_reg
anchors.why: Registered header ready loaded with grant on frame start.

anchors.name: s_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Packed per-port header fields selected by grant index.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Packed per-port payload data muxed by grant index.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-port payload valid; with tlast acknowledges arbiter at frame end.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready routed only to the granted port.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker ending frame state and arbiter grant.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid from header valid register.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready allowing next frame start and clearing valid.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Latched header of the granted frame held for output.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Muxed payload output from output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer valid register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready controlling skid buffer transfers.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index selects header and payload source port.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant masking requests, acknowledging and driving header ready.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Grant present; gates frame start and payload ready/valid.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter requests from header-valid ports not granted.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Arbiter release on last payload beat of granted port.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating input acceptance and buffer stores.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid of selected payload into skid buffer.

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Selected port payload data slice.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output payload register stage.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer register holding payload while output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer occupied flag affecting internal ready.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads selected payload into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads selected payload into skid buffer registers.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves skid buffer payload to output registers.

groups.name: Input arbitration
groups.description: Arbiter grants one header-valid port per frame; released on tlast.

groups.name: Frame and header control
groups.description: Frame FSM accepts granted header and latches MAC/type for output.

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Selects granted port payload beats into internal datapath.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output plus temp registers giving full-throughput AXI-Stream output.
